settings.headline: Confidence starts with comfort.
settings.subhead: Senseless is a system — match the strength and the format to the appointment you've booked. Three strengths, three formats, formulated in the UK.
settings.image_alt: Senseless topical preparation range arranged on a warm off-white background with a purple brand accent
settings.caption: The Senseless range — formulated in the UK.

settings.label: Clinical Strength
settings.heading: For standard appointments
settings.body: The baseline of the system — the formula most appointments call for. Formulated for shorter sessions and smaller treatment areas: top-ups, routine microneedling, contained laser work. Precise where it counts.
settings.image_alt: Clinical Strength Senseless preparation on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Advanced Strength
settings.heading: For longer or more demanding work
settings.body: A higher-strength formula, made for longer appointments and more sensitive treatment areas. The strength studios reach for when a session asks more of the skin. For when the appointment asks more.
settings.image_alt: Advanced Strength Senseless preparation on a warm off-white background

settings.label: Professional Strength
settings.heading: Our highest-strength formula
settings.body: Developed with practitioners and used in studios across the UK. The highest strength in the system — available without restriction. Trusted at the chair.
settings.image_alt: Professional Strength Senseless preparation on a warm off-white background

settings.headline: Match the strength to your session.
settings.body: Strength is the first half of your selection. Clinical for routine, shorter sessions. Advanced for longer or more sensitive work. Professional for the most demanding. Not a budget ladder — each is built for a different intensity. Format is the other half: cream, gel or spray, just below.

settings.heading: Not sure which to choose?
settings.body: Answer three quick questions — your treatment, your skin and how long the session runs — and we'll point you to the format and strength we'd reach for.

settings.headline: Cream, Gel, and Spray.
settings.body: Three formats, one system. Cream covers most appointments; Gel and Spray each have their place — and many clients keep more than one.

settings.headline: A cosmetic product. Built for aesthetics.
settings.body: Senseless is a UK cosmetic product. Not a medicine. Not pharmacy. A topical preparation developed for the way modern aesthetic appointments actually work: short windows between booking and the chair, sensitive treatment areas, and clients who care about the experience as much as the result.
settings.image_alt: Editorial close-up of a Senseless topical preparation in soft warm light

settings.headline: For studios and practitioners.
settings.body: Senseless is stocked in studios and professional settings across the UK. Wholesale accounts for practitioners working at volume — account pricing and the consistency a busy schedule needs from its supply.
